course_name: 建築資訊規劃、管理與分析模型
outline:
本課程主要在教導學生探討建築專案施工的過程：規劃施工階段、管理進度排程、控制施工順序與建置各階段結構分析模型。
Exposition to the concepts of construction processes, modeling of construction operations, the use of queuing, line of balance, simulation of construction processes.
schedule:
Week 01: Network Model and Precedence Diagrams
Week 02: Activity Durations and Time In Contract Provision
Week 03: Money, Network, & Short-Interval Schedules
Week 04: Computer and Linear Scheduling
Week 05: Network-based Critical Path Methods (CPM)
Week 06: Time Planning Process and Activity
Week 07: No Class
Week 08: Program Evaluation & Review Technique (PERT)
Week 09: Midterm Exam
Week 10: Resource Allocation and Leveling
Week 11: Project Monitoring, Time & Cost Control
Week 12: Evaluation of Work Changes & Delays
Week 13: Impact of Scheduling Decisions on Productivity
Week 14: Simulation in Construction Processes
Week 15: BIM and construction management
Week 16: BIM Project Execution Planning Procedure
Week 17: BIM Preconstruction and Construction
Week 18: Final Exam

(Subject to change based on class progress!)
assessment:
1. Midterm & Final Exams: 50%
2. Assignments: 30%
3. Participation: 20%

(Subject to change based on class progress!)
